title: Sources: Anthropic's IPO is about six times oversubscribed, and bankers have told prospective investors that existing backers will be prioritized (Bailey Lipschultz/Bloomberg)
summary: Bailey Lipschultz / Bloomberg: Sources: Anthropic's IPO is about six times oversubscribed, and bankers have told prospective investors that existing backers will be prioritized — Anthropic PBC's initial public offering has drawn about six times the orders for the shares available, according to people familiar with the matter …
